title: Industry Pulse - AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: LEAD - 'PLUGIN4SHELL': A ZERO-CLICK RCE THAT DEFEATS PLUGIN SHA PINNING IN CLAUDE CODE, CODEX, GITHUB COPILOT AND GEMINI CLI - THE FIRST SUPPLY-CHAIN VULNERABILITY OF THE AI-AGENT ECOSYSTEM, AND IT REACHES PEOPLE WHO DID EVERYTHING RIGHT: AN ALREADY-INSTALLED, REVIEWED, PINNED PLUGIN IS SWAPPED FOR MALICIOUS CODE BY BACKGROUND AUTO-UPDATE WITH NO PROMPT AND NOTHING TO NOTICE
bullets.summary: AIR research primary dated 17 September 2026 (Or Nevo, Dor Granat, Niv Hoffman); Help Net Security published 2026-09-18T08:49Z. Mechanism read at the primary: the agent clones the plugin repo and runs 'git checkout <40-hex pinned SHA>' but never verifies the commit that landed in the working tree. An attacker controlling the repo creates a BRANCH named exactly like the pinned SHA and makes it default; git prefers a ref over an object of the same name and prints only an 'ambiguous refname' warning, so attacker code is checked out while the agent reports a successful install AT THE PINNED COMMIT. Gemini CLI has a separate variant where a default branch named FETCH_HEAD defeats 'git checkout FETCH_HEAD'. One assertion closes both - test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "<pinned-sha>" || abort - and it MUST run inside the agent, because the pin is resolved on the client and no marketplace can enforce it. Zero-click because the same checkout re-runs on background plugin auto-update, the default in Claude Code and Codex. PATCH STATUS: Anthropic fixed Claude Code in 2.1.179 (confirmed 2026-06-17); OpenAI fixed Codex in 0.146.0 (verified 2026-08-12); Microsoft has shipped nothing for Copilot; Google will not patch Gemini CLI because it is deprecated, so every install stays vulnerable permanently. Archive grep across 82 files: Plugin4Shell ZERO, zero-click ZERO, SHA pinning ZERO, SkillJacking ZERO, MCPJacking ZERO, RepoJacking ZERO, 2.1.179 ZERO.
bullets.how: YES, and the first item in twenty days with a same-morning action rather than a design lesson. (i) WE ARE ALMOST CERTAINLY PATCHED AND THAT IS THE LEAST INTERESTING PART - the changelog primary confirms 2.1.278, far past 2.1.179, but 'probably fine' is exactly the reasoning item (r) exists to refuse. The check is 'claude --version' on EVERY surface: the Mac, Hermes' environment, and any IDE-bundled CLI - 2.1.277 itself fixed being logged out when an older IDE-bundled build runs on the same machine, which is precisely the exposed configuration and we already know we have had one. (ii) THE 19 SEP FIRE READ THE PATCH AND DID NOT KNOW IT WAS A PATCH - yesterday's 06:00 fire bulleted 2.1.277's plugin-commit lines (installed_plugins.json recorded without its commit; keeping the old commit after updating a pinned-commit plugin; reinstall breaking the installed copy) as hygiene. Those are commit-identity repairs in the exact code path this vulnerability abuses. (iii) THE EXPOSURE IS OURS SPECIFICALLY - the Construct runs anthropic-skills plus searchfit-seo, design, finance, legal, marketing, operations, productivity and cowork-plugin-management from marketplaces with auto-update on, inside an agent holding the Mac GitHub credential and the DreamHost deploy SSH key. AIR's stated blast radius is full access to every asset the agent can reach: brand9signs.com, nanabuns.com, hartley-command, ANS/APS. The 19 Sep design requirement 'the log must record what ran the action' now has a concrete asset list attached. (iv) THE ARCHIVE WAS CARRYING THE WRONG AIR - 'AIR' appears in 20 files and air.security in exactly one; the 1 Sep $50M raise has been a pending competitor line for two fires. We tracked the company as a funding datapoint while its research was the news, including MCPJacking (27 Aug, 155 hijackable MCPs live in the official marketplace via expired domains) and SkillJacking (925 in-use skills hijacked, 134,000 agents), both archive-ZERO.

bullets.title: A CCTV-AFFILIATED OUTLET ESCALATED ON 19 SEP TO ITS MOST SERIOUS ANTHROPIC ATTACK YET - A CLAUSE-BY-CLAUSE READ OF ALL 13 PRIVACY-POLICY REVISIONS SINCE 2023 ARGUING ANTHROPIC HAS BUILT ITSELF INTO A US 'INTELLIGENCE HUB' - AND THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART IS THAT ITS LOAD-BEARING FACT IS TRUE AND WESTERN-SOURCED: NVIDIA, PALANTIR, BOOZ ALLEN AND A MAJOR US UTILITY HAVE ALL RESTRICTED ANTHROPIC'S TOP MODELS OVER THE SAME DATA-RETENTION TERMS
bullets.summary: Yuyuan Tantian (CCTV-affiliated) published 19 September; full translation dateline read at the page (meta-article:modified_time 2026-09-19T14:43:40Z), also carried by Bloomberg 19 Sep. It stages three phases: overseas-to-US data transfer (Canada, Brazil, South Korea, EU, from May 2024); user-data source categories expanding from three to six between June 2024 and September 2025 with training defaults flipping to opt-in-by-default in Sep 2025; and intelligence linkage - a 23 Feb 2026 report alleging Chinese model 'distillation' that stated Anthropic was sharing technical indicators with intelligence agencies, a 10 Jun 2026 Senate letter citing 28.8M conversations and 25,000 accounts, July 2026 Threat Intelligence Manager postings preferring Mandarin/Russian fluency, government or military intelligence experience and US Top Secret clearance, and a 10 Sep 2026 report analysing ~200M Claude interactions, cited by Amodei two days later in his 12 Sep 'slow down' proposals. CORROBORATING SUBSTRATE (PYMNTS 2026-09-15T23:34Z, sourced to The Information - outside the window, declared as substrate not as new): Nvidia confines Fable to low-stakes work and routes supply-chain monitoring to its own Nemotron models while remaining an Anthropic investor; Palantir will not offer Fable absent an irrevocable ZDR guarantee; Booz Allen bars Fable near its proprietary cyber code; a major US utility scrapped a Fable pilot on core power infrastructure. Anthropic's answer, unveiled 1 Sep as Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), keeps retained data in the customer's own cloud under the customer's own keys, broadening this fall. Archive grep: Yuyuan ZERO, CCTV ZERO, privacy overhaul ZERO, Palantir ZERO, ZDR ZERO, Novo Nordisk ZERO.
bullets.how: YES, but only read correctly - and the correct reading needs the vendor primary the article does not cite. (i) VERIFY THE LOAD-BEARING FACT BEFORE DISMISSING THE SOURCE: it holds, via The Information and PYMNTS, not via Chinese state media. (ii) THE VENDOR PRIMARY CORRECTS THE FRAMING AND THAT CORRECTION IS THE OPERATIONALLY USEFUL FACT: read at support.claude.com, the 30-day retention (up to two years if flagged) applies to COVERED MODELS - Mythos-class - effective 9 June 2026, and consumer plans (Free, Pro, Max) across web, desktop and mobile INCLUDING Claude.ai and Claude Code are explicitly unaffected because those surfaces already retain. It bites only organizations that had ZDR workspaces in Console, ZDR Claude Code under Enterprise, or ZDR via Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform or Azure Foundry. For The Construct as configured today the item-(r) answer is NOTHING CHANGES, and we stop there. (iii) THE ITEM THAT IS ACTUALLY OURS IS PRAGMA'S AND IT IS A SALES FACT: the last ninety days established that retention terms now decide deployments as firmly as model quality - Microsoft restricting its own staff in June, four named enterprises in September, a utility cancelling a pilot. The first PRAGMA prospect with a compliance function will ask 'which model, retained where, under whose keys, reviewed by whom' and we cannot answer it in one page. EFS, customer-held keys and the Covered-Models boundary belong on a one-page PRAGMA data-handling sheet this week. TRUTH GATE for any client-facing use: Chinese-source allegations are claims of that source; enterprise restrictions are reported by The Information via PYMNTS; retention mechanics are read at Anthropic's own primary. Those three tiers must not be flattened into one.

bullets.title: TRUMP SAID ON 19 SEP HE WILL APPOINT AN AI CZAR AND STAND UP AN 'AI FORCE' MODELLED ON THE SPACE FORCE, WHILE EXPLICITLY REJECTING THE GUARDRAILS AMODEI, ALTMAN AND MUSK HAD JOINTLY CALLED FOR SEVEN DAYS EARLIER - THE FEDERAL ANSWER TO THE 12 SEP 'SLOW DOWN' CONSENSUS IS AN ACCELERATION POSTURE WITH A MILITARY FRAME
bullets.summary: Announced in a long Saturday social-media post, 19 September 2026, covered by the Washington Post, CNN, NBC News and Al Jazeera the same day. An AI adviser role, unnamed ('only High I.Q. individuals need apply'), plus an unspecified 'AI Force' likened to the Space Force he created in his first term, framed around AI as 'the next Industrial Revolution' and protecting its development. No appointee, no timeline, no structural detail. Archive grep across 82 files: 'AI czar' ZERO, 'AI Force' ZERO.
bullets.how: MAYBE - a watch item, deliberately not more. (i) IT CLOSES A WEEK THE ARCHIVE ALREADY OPENED: the 19 Sep 10:00 fire recorded at Anthropic's own primary that NO standard exists for evaluator access or reporting and NO settled funding system exists, with the June Advanced AI Framework proposing pooled or governmental funding; the Yuyuan Tantian piece notes Altman endorsed exactly one of Amodei's 12 Sep proposals - independent third-party evaluators - and Musk said 'Dario is right.' Seven days later the federal direction is a czar and a force, not a standard and a funder. If the pooled/governmental path is closed, vendor-funded evaluation (Anthropic paying Accenture and naming the conflict) is not transitional, it is the arrangement - and PRAGMA's 'graded by the party the client pays' problem has no external standard arriving to rescue it either. (ii) IT STAYS A MAYBE ON PURPOSE: a Saturday post with no appointee, charter or date is a stated intention. It goes to item (h) as a watch alongside the FRONTIER Act and the Thune-Cruz-Klobuchar bill, re-read when a name or a document exists. This report has been wrong in the other direction recently - five fires past the Cowork merge - but the corrective for that was ENUMERATE THE SUBJECT, not upgrade every announcement.

praxis_lesson: TWENTY DAYS OF THIS REPORT HAVE HAD NO SECURITY LANE, AND THE FIRST DAY IT ACCIDENTALLY ACQUIRED ONE THE SECURITY ITEM WAS THE LEAD - AND WORSE, WE HAD ALREADY READ THE FIX WITHOUT KNOWING WHAT IT WAS. Yesterday's 06:00 fire read Claude Code 2.1.277 at the primary and bulleted its plugin-commit lines as housekeeping: installed_plugins.json recorded without its commit, keeping the old commit after updating a pinned-commit plugin, a reinstall breaking the installed copy. Those are commit-identity repairs in the exact code path Plugin4Shell abuses, published the same week a research lab disclosed that every one of the four major coding agents checks out a pinned SHA and never verifies the commit that landed. We had the remediation surface and the calendar and still could not see the vulnerability, because a changelog read as a FEATURE feed cannot show you a FIX. The lesson generalises past this report: the same artifact read under a different question yields different facts, so A SOURCE LIST IS NOT A LANE LIST - THE LANE IS THE QUESTION YOU BRING, and 'what did somebody find broken' is a question we have never once asked. That is new item (s), and unlike the six intake patches before it, it is not another revision of the window. SECOND, THE ONE FOR BOBBY THIS MORNING: THE CONSTRUCT'S RISK PROFILE IS NOT 'WE MIGHT INSTALL SOMETHING CARELESS', IT IS THAT WE DID EVERYTHING RIGHT AND THE GUARANTEE WE RELIED ON WAS NOT ENFORCED. AIR's finding is that the victim only has to ALREADY HAVE a reviewed, pinned plugin installed; auto-update does the rest with no prompt. We run a large marketplace plugin surface in an agent holding the GitHub credential and the deploy key for every property we own. We are on 2.1.278 and therefore almost certainly patched - and 'almost certainly' is the phrase item (r) was invented to delete. Three small actions, none of them a plan: 'claude --version' on every surface including any IDE-bundled CLI; an inventory of installed plugins and MCPs against the MCPJacking method that found 155 hijackable servers in the official marketplace; and the credential grep item (k) has carried unexecuted for twenty-one days, which is today the single highest-value unrun item on the list. THIRD, A QUIET WIN WORTH NAMING BECAUSE THIS REPORT USUALLY ONLY NAMES FAILURES: ITEM (r) PRODUCED A NEGATIVE AND WE STOPPED. Anthropic's 30-day retention change reads, in Chinese state media and in a fair amount of Western coverage, like a policy that applies to everyone; read at the vendor's own primary it applies to Covered Models and explicitly exempts consumer Free/Pro/Max on web, desktop, Claude.ai and Claude Code, biting only prior-ZDR organizations. The correct output was 'nothing changes for us', recorded and dropped. A scan that can only escalate is not measuring anything; the discipline that makes an alarm worth reading is the willingness to file a non-event - which is also, precisely, what PRAGMA sells, and what separates AAIR from a dashboard that only ever goes up.
